name: knowledge-synthesis
description: The three-node pattern: look up what's known, synthesize with it, write the result back as one canonical item. Spends exactly one model call.

topic.help: What to synthesize. Also the item's identity, so re-running updates rather than duplicating.

material.help: New material to fold in. Left empty, this re-synthesizes from what is already stored.

metadata.why_one_call: Both the retrieve and the persist are zero-token action providers, so the only model call is the synthesis itself. Doing either through a stage would triple the cost for no gain.

steering_examples.description: Synthesize what we know about cold start latency, folding in today's measurements.
The retrieved context is stale — ignore items older than a month and re-synthesize.

example_outputs: one consolidated article about a topic, stored and searchable
metadata.when_not_to_use: not for questions the store cannot answer yet — use deep-research

children.label: Is the synthesis grounded in the sources?
